190. Supplementary budget.—

—   Supplementary   budget   may   be   prepared   and 
submitted whenever necessary. The Zilla Panchayat may at any time during the year for 
which a budget has been sanctioned by the Government, cause a supplementary budget to 
be prepared and submitted to the Government. Every such supplementary budget shall be 
considered and approved by the Zilla Panchayat and submitted to the Government for 
approval.
